{{Short description|Norwegian nuclear chemist}}
'''Jorolf Alstad''' (6 April 1927 – 21 November 2014) was a Norwegian [[nuclear chemist]].

He was born in [[Frol Municipality|Frol]].<ref>{{cite news|title=70 år|date=6 April 1997|work=Aftenposten|page=27|language=no}}</ref> In his younger days he was a ski jumper and football player for Frol IL, later Akademisk BK in Oslo.<ref>{{cite book|last=Brustad|first=Arne|author-link=Arne Brustad|title=Aktive fotballspillere|volume=1|year=1952|publisher=Idrettsforlaget|location=Oslo|language=no|page=592}}</ref>

Graduating with the [[cand.real.]] degree in 1957, he was a student of [[Alexis Pappas]]. He was appointed as an [[associate professor]] of nuclear chemistry at the University of Oslo in 1964, advancing to professor in 1991.<ref name=obit1/> He had research stints at [[CERN]], the [[École européenne de chimie, polymères et matériaux]] and the [[Japan Atomic Energy Research Institute|Tokai Research Establishment]].<ref>{{cite news|title=75 år|date=6 April 2002|work=Aftenposten|page=23|language=no}}</ref> His fields of expertise included [[Extraction (chemistry)|extraction]], [[ion exchange]] and the chemistry of [[rare-earth mineral]]s.<ref name=obit1/> He was inducted into the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] in 1983.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26857|title=Norske medlemmer|publisher=Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters|access-date=2 September 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070715142138/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26857|archive-date=15 July 2007}}</ref>

He frequented the University of Oslo as a [[professor emeritus]] up until his death in November 2014, aged 87.<ref name=obit1>{{cite news|title=Jorolf Alstad|last=Omtvedt|first=Jon Petter|date=6 December 2014|work=Aftenposten|page=61|language=no|display-authors=etal}}</ref>
